THE SPLIT PLATE / RECIPE

Chocolate Chip Cookie Cake Creami

Cookie-cake protein Creami with chocolate chips and quick cocoa-maple fudge. About 340 calories per finished pint and 40g protein from the base.

YIELD1 serving
TOTAL TIME10 min active + 24 hr freeze
COOK METHODSee method
EST. / SERVING~340 cal
KEY TO SUCCESS: Each ingredient list makes one complete finished pint; do not divide the calories by multiple servings.

Ingredients

BASE (ONE PINT)

  • 1 cup Fairlife 2% ultra-filtered milk
  • 2 tbsp monk-fruit/erythritol sweetener
  • 1 serving unflavored whey isolate
  • 1/8 tsp guar gum (level measure)
  • Pinch of salt

TOP AFTER SPINNING

  • 1 tbsp Maple Grove Farms sugar-free maple syrup
  • 1/2 tbsp cocoa

BLEND IN BEFORE FREEZING

  • 1/4 tsp butter extract
  • 1 tsp vanilla extract
  • 1 drop natural brown food coloring

AFTER FIRST SPIN: MACHINE MIX-IN

  • 7g Lily's milk-chocolate chips
  • 50 calories' worth of Hormbles Chormbles milk chocolate

Allergens: dairy. Contains dairy; check all current packaged labels for additional allergens.

You want a homemade protein Creami inspired by a cookie-shop flavor. The shared base contributes about 40g protein before flavor additions; the finished pint is about 340 calories.

Method

  1. 1.BLEND. Combine 1 cup Fairlife 2% ultra-filtered milk, 2 tbsp monk-fruit/erythritol sweetener, 1 serving unflavored whey isolate, 1/8 tsp guar gum (level measure), Pinch of salt with 1/4 tsp butter extract, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 1 drop natural brown food coloring. Blend until smooth.
  2. 2.FREEZE. Pour into a Creami pint below the max-fill line. Freeze upright and level for 24 hours.
  3. 3.FIRST SPIN. Rest five minutes. Run Regular Ice Cream. If powdery, run a no-water Respin.
  4. 4.MIX-IN. After the first spin, add 7g Lily's milk-chocolate chips and 50 calories' worth of Hormbles Chormbles milk chocolate; run Mix-In.
  5. 5.FINISH. Whisk the syrup and cocoa until smooth, then drizzle the fudge over the finished pint. Serve immediately.

Keys to success

  • Blend flavor additions before freezing, run Regular Ice Cream, and use a no-water Respin only if powdery.
  • Add toppings after spinning so their texture stays distinct.

If something fails

Powdery after first spin: Run one no-water Respin.

Gummy texture: Use a level 1/8 teaspoon of guar gum, not a heaped scoop.

Storage and reheating

Store: Freeze the unprocessed pint upright and level; spin and add toppings when ready to eat.

Reheat: Not applicable.

Lasts: Process within a week for best texture.

Estimated nutrition

~340 cal.
